heading: What's new in doXmind
subtitle: Every improvement, new feature, and fix — tracked and documented. Follow the evolution of your writing assistant.

cta.heading: Try the latest features today
cta.description: Every update is available instantly. Start writing with AI for free.

v0_6.title: Presentation & Polish
v0_6.summary: Present your documents as beautiful slide decks, plus a redesigned landing page, a dedicated help center, and dark mode refinements across the board.
added: Presentation Mode — full-screen slide view that splits documents by delimiter, with keyboard and swipe navigation
Marketing Landing Page — redesigned demo page as a proper marketing landing with inline text color support
Help Page — new help center with typography settings (font, line height, etc.) that sync across the editor and presentation mode
Shared Document Outline — outline sidebar in the shared document view with auto-hiding scrollbars
Dark Mode enhancements — global dark theme refinements for a more consistent visual experience
fixed: Home dashboard scrolling issue caused by incorrect FlexBox layout
Dropdown sub-menu hover states not responding correctly
Heroku Redis self-signed SSL certificate compatibility in the rate limiter

v0_5.title: Block Editor & Onboarding
v0_5.summary: A richer, more intuitive editing experience with Notion-style block handles, an interactive onboarding tour for new users, and fine-grained typography controls.
added: Notion-style Block Handles — drag handles for blocks, row and column controls for tables, and a unified header layout
Interactive Onboarding Tour — step-by-step guided walkthrough that introduces key features to new users
Typography Settings — configurable font family, size, and line height for a personalized writing environment
Trash System — soft-delete files to a recoverable trash bin instead of permanent deletion
S3 Image Upload — images are now uploaded to S3 object storage for reliable hosting
Rich Editor Blocks — new block types including horizontal rules, callouts, and more
Resizable Panels & Focus Mode — drag to resize side panels, plus a distraction-free focus writing mode
Design Refresh — updated visual language across the entire application
improved: Backend hardening — security and stability improvements across server infrastructure

v0_4.title: Editor Intelligence & File Organization
v0_4.summary: A smarter editor powered by agentic RAG, a redesigned diff review experience, folder organization, math support, and adaptive autocomplete modes.
added: KB Agent (Agentic RAG) — a new Knowledge Base agent that performs intelligent cross-document Q&A and retrieval
Diff Review Redesign — Apple HIG-inspired review interface with hunk navigation and focus highlighting
Folder System — single-level folders with drag-and-drop sorting, multi-select operations, and file categorization
Math Support — inline and block-level math formula menus with improved LaTeX input rules
Adaptive Autocomplete — three completion modes (short, long, and adaptive) with RAG-powered context assembly
URL-based File Routing — file navigation via URL paths, cross-page drag-and-drop, and editor save reliability fixes
improved: Replaced insert_text with paragraph-level precision navigation and structured editing feedback
Extracted modular Chat component library from monolithic AI components
Codebase-wide formatting with Prettier and Tailwind class sorting

v0_3.title: Security, Mobile & Dashboard
v0_3.summary: Bring your own API key, a brand-new home dashboard, mobile editing support, and significant authentication hardening.
added: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) — manage your own API keys with encrypted storage, validation, and security safeguards
Home Dashboard — a new landing experience with auth-aware routing, portal dropdown menus, and animated text effects
Mobile Editor — responsive editing mode switching, scroll-spy outline navigation, and improved file rename UX
Auth Hardening — comprehensive security improvements across the authentication flow
improved: Decomposed monolithic modules, removed unused code, and improved overall maintainability

v0_2.title: Platform Infrastructure
v0_2.summary: Foundational platform capabilities — data file support, a demo mode for showcasing the product, and a proper database migration system.
added: Data Files & Code Execution — upload data files and run code against them directly in the platform
Demo Mode — simulated AI responses for product demonstrations and walkthroughs
Alembic Migration System — structured database migration framework for reliable schema evolution

v0_1.title: Search & RAG Overhaul
v0_1.summary: The foundation of doXmind — a hybrid search engine combining keyword and vector retrieval, parallel embeddings, and the first iteration of the skills system.
added: Hybrid Search (RRF Fusion) — search engine combining keyword and vector retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion scoring
Knowledge Base Hybrid Search — the same powerful hybrid retrieval applied to your uploaded documents
Parallel Batch Embedding — vectorization runs in parallel batches with automatic retry logic
History Compression — chat history compression with content-hash deduplication to reduce token usage
Skills System — reorganized skill architecture with a new legal case search skill
File Summaries & Favorites — generate summaries for files and mark important ones as favorites
Token Usage Tracking — monitor token consumption per conversation with soft-delete for messages
Search Evaluation — offline relevance evaluation scripts for continuous search quality testing
improved: CJK font support in PDF exports for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean documents
Refined search result type definitions for better downstream handling
